bad425ed65a2.summary: We're hiring a Head of Deployment to be the quarterback of client success. You will lead and scale the team responsible for turning our AI RCM platform into real commercial and production value for our healthcare customers.
does: Own the outcomes. Go-live within 6 weeks of contract signing, pilot conversion, retention, and expansion across every account are your OKRs. Your team runs the deployments; you are accountable for the results.
Build and lead the team. Coach and set the bar for the ADS team. Design roles, structure, and incentives so they reward outcomes, and add capacity ahead of demand.

Orchestrate across Amperos. You are the customer's voice inside the company. Work backward from the outcomes you own, and tell each team what the customer needs from them: the expectations GTM sets in pre-sales, what…

Own value realization. After go-live, make Amperos's in-platform reporting the source of truth each customer relies on for the outcomes they bought. Use your knowledge of their workflows and business to drive adoption…
Own how we deploy. Own the playbook for each product, from handoff and kickoff to exit criteria and retros. Make sure every ADS runs it the same way, and change it when it stops working.
Turn every contract into outcomes. Make sure your team knows the terms we sign and what each buyer expects, and turns both into a plan that delivers.
wants: 7+ years in deployment, implementation, or consulting, mostly in client-facing roles.
Experienced people leader. 3+ years building and managing a team, including hiring, coaching, and setting goals.
Experience at a tech company is required. Experience in healthcare or an AI company is highly preferred.
Commercial instincts. You read a contract and know what it takes to deliver what the customer bought. You spot risks to renewal and expansion early.
Highly organized. You create structure where none exists, such as plans, agendas, request lists, and trackers, and you follow through with high attention to detail.
A strategic thinker. You work backward from an outcome, tell other teams clearly and early what the customer needs, and follow through until it's done.

aac4952e5010.summary: Samsara's Go-To-Market AI product team builds the internal products our sellers, customer success managers, and support reps use every day. As Director, AI Product Management (GTM), you will own an AI-powered GTM platform that creates a step change in impact, brings in new ways of working, centralizes data and insights, and acts as the foundational system for our GTM organization—from problem identification to development, adoption, and measurable business impact.
does: Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our internal AI-native GTM platform, and be accountable for whether the business adopts it.
Manage the platform as one portfolio, so every part of it shares the same data, intelligence and building blocks, and users get one consistent experience.

Build an AI-native product practice. Take the best of traditional product management, such as PRDs, prioritization, launch readiness and measurement, and reinvent it with AI so the team moves faster and builds better.
Understand internal users' problems and analyze data to identify what to build, sometimes finding the need before users can articulate it.
Write clear requirements and partner closely with engineering, which leads technical implementation, to deliver a high-quality product. Make sure you and your team test the product firsthand.

Keep pace with an engineering team that moves fast and ships at high velocity. Gather input from the field quickly, turn it into a clear direction for engineering, and use AI to shorten the loop from feedback to shipped…
wants: 10+ years of experience in product management, or in strategy and operations roles where you owned a product built with engineering.
5+ years of experience leading, developing and mentoring product managers or product-oriented teams, while staying close to execution.
Demonstrated ownership of an internal or business-facing product, including defining the problem, working with engineering to deliver it, driving adoption and showing measurable business impact.
Hands-on experience with AI, such as building or shipping AI-enabled products, using AI tools in your own work, or prototyping with them.
Strong analytical skills, with examples of using data to identify problems, shape product decisions and measure results.
Technical fluency and ability to establish credibility with engineers.

fa769711f6c9.summary: Please apply only if you are seeking a temporary, part-time role and can work in person in Berkeley. Weekly hours and assignment duration will be discussed during the interview process.
does: Build and improve Python scripts and lightweight internal tools that reduce manual work.
Use LLM APIs and other AI tools to help teams find information and automate workflows.
Connect APIs, databases, and internal systems to make information easier to access and use.
Clean and analyze engineering and field data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, and ground uplift.
Create simple dashboards and reports to help the team track performance.
Test your work, document how to use it, and improve it based on feedback from engineers and operators.
wants: Ability to work in person in Berkeley on a part-time schedule for a temporary assignment.
Working knowledge of Python and evidence that you can build and debug a useful script or application.
Some hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI tools, or workflow automation through coursework, personal projects, or prior work.
Basic familiarity with APIs, databases, SQL, or data analysis tools such as Pandas.
Willingness to work with messy real-world data, ask questions, and learn from feedback.
Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and interest in robotics, manufacturing, or field operations.

5a9463fbf11e.summary: You'll run Agent Operations within Customer Success, working under the direction of the VP, Customer Success & Engagement, who owns Luna's strategy and roadmap. Your focus is keeping Luna accurate, trusted and widely used across Luna 1.0 in production and Luna 2.0 as it rolls out. You'll train Luna continuously, watch its quality through telemetry, help customers get the most from it, and turn what customers do with it into clear improvements to the product, the documentation and the agent's skills.
does: Luna's day-to-day operation and quality, for Luna 1.0 in production and Luna 2.0 as it launches
Adoption: how many customers use Luna, and how much they rely on it to complete work, not just get answers
The operating rhythm ("AgentOps") that keeps Luna improving: training, evaluation, telemetry and feedback loops

2ac8bb3c5682.summary: Twenty builds AI-enabled technology for mission-critical cyber operations. We're seeking a Staff Product Manager to help make agentic AI systems measurable, reliable, and continuously improvable. You’ll partner with AI and engineering teams to shape evaluation capabilities—from defining agent performance and product quality to turning results into useful workflows and product decisions.
does: Own or support the product roadmap for agentic AI evaluations, translating product-area goals into clear priorities and outcomes.
Partner closely with engineering and AI teams to understand evaluation needs, technical constraints, and user workflows.
Define how agent performance and product quality should be assessed, including useful measures of task success, reliability, and quality.
Turn technical evaluation needs into clear product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
Help operationalize evaluation workflows and success metrics so teams can consistently assess agent behavior and product changes.
Use evaluation results and feedback to identify gaps, inform product decisions, and improve the agent experience over time.
wants: You're a product-minded, technically curious operator who is excited about how agentic systems work and how to make them better.
You bring strong product judgment and can turn complex technical needs into clear, usable product direction.
You enjoy partnering with engineers and AI teams, asking good questions, and working through ambiguity together.
You are rigorous about evidence and metrics, while recognizing that evaluation methods need to reflect real user and product needs.
You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable balancing learning, execution, and iteration.

9a8f0eeb9ac9.summary: We're hiring founding Deployment Strategists for our Growth & Delivery team. The team deploys Lightfield for customers, delivers their pipeline generation motion, supports strategic deals alongside our leadership team, and drives special projects across GTM and business operations.
does: Own each customer's deployment end to end: set up their workspace, migrate their data, build their customer memory, and enable their team, so Lightfield becomes the system their company runs on
Deliver pipeline generation for a portfolio of customers: understand each business, define the ICP and targeting strategy, and direct Lightfield's agents from first outreach to booked meetings
Advise founders and GTM leaders on their go-to-market and how to put AI agents to work in it
Own the outcomes: time-to-activation, meetings booked, and the quality of the pipeline behind them
Support strategic deals alongside our leadership team, from scoping POCs to helping convert evaluations into customers
Take on special projects across GTM and business operations, from business analysis to competitive research to new initiatives
wants: 3+ years of experience in consulting, banking, investing, or go-to-market and operating roles
A strong generalist, comfortable across delivery, growth, and customer-facing work. You don't wait to be handed a lane and instead figure out what needs to happen and do it

A trusted advisor to founders and GTM leaders - curious and analytical, able to read a business and its customers quickly, move from qualitative signals to a clear hypothesis, and back your view with data.
A systems thinker who brings structure to open-ended problems and builds playbooks and repeatable processes, not just completed tasks
High agency and thrives in ambiguity, able to independently drive projects and deliver results in a fast-moving environment
Comfortable going technical: you can reason about data models and integrations, configure workflows, and tune how an agent behaves

aa145a4d0806.summary: At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data.
does: Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.

6a32ba3d014b.summary: As the Staff Product Manager - AI Inference, you will lead CoreWeave's strategic efforts in shaping and developing cutting-edge AI inference services that drive innovation and business outcomes for our customers. You will collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and industry partners to create world-class products that empower organizations to build, deploy, scale, and optimize AI models and applications efficiently and effectively.

Roadmap Development: Own the product roadmap for AI inference services, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term vision, to deliver differentiated and scalable AI cloud services.

AI and Cloud Expertise: Stay current on advancements in AI/ML technologies including inference engines, model serving architectures, cloud infrastructures, and software development methodologies to inform product…

Define product portfolio: Manage ambiguity and complexity of a fast evolving AI landscape to define new product investments and develop a portfolio of inference capabilities that deliver long-term differentiation and…
Customer Engagement: Collaborate with key customers to understand their AI workloads, pain points, and future requirements to continuously improve our service offerings.
Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure seamless product development and deployment.
wants: Experience: 8+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5 years in the cloud services or AI/ML market segment.

Technical Knowledge: Hands on practitioner and deep understanding of AI/ML workloads including foundation model inference, inference engines such as vllm, SGLang, TensorRT-llm, and llm-d, inference optimization…

Customer-Centric Approach: Demonstrated experience working closely with customers to identify needs and translate them into product features and solutions.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

bad96e89edd5.summary: It is also not primarily a scheduling, meeting-notes, or project-administration role. While you will help coordinate projects and keep work moving, the core of this position is understanding workflows, building solutions, testing them with employees, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

Build and improve practical AI solutions, including reusable prompts, skills, plugins, workflows, and automations using approved no-code or low-code tools.
Test solutions with employees, document how to use them, and measure results related to efficiency, quality, and employee experience.
Establish clear success measures with department leaders before building solutions.
